# Logic Loops AI

Logic Loops AI builds AI-powered business automations and hosts them on managed servers, keeping them running 24/7 for SMEs across the UK, US, Australia, and Canada. We handle lead automation, operations automation, AI agents, and CRM integration on Make.com, n8n, and Zapier.
